EmailTemplate.name: Case Management Survey
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
ASU values your experience and wants to ensure that you receive quality service.
We would like to get your feedback on the service you received regarding ASU Case {!Case.CaseNumber}, "{!Case.Subject}".
Start Survey: https://asu.getfeedback.com/r/fWD3ZfaE?Case_ID={!Case.Id}&name={!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for your time and feedback.
